text: I always fail and everything is ruined. I feel awful and I can't stop replaying it. I keep thinking I messed everything up and I hate myself for it. I feel bad and stressed and ashamed, and I keep replaying what I said and what they thought and what I should have done. I am exhausted and I feel like I will always be this way.
I am noticing the thought that I might fail, and I can ask for help and prepare one step at a time.
I feel anticipatory dread before the meeting, tight chest and restless stomach, but I can still act on my values.
Estoy muy estresado y todo saldrá mal; siempre arruino las cosas.
I skipped the gym and avoided the call because I felt ashamed.
